title: Finding the Right Platform
summaryZh: 旅客在火車站詢問往台中的列車月台、行走方向和驗票方式。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Excuse me, which platform is for the train to Taichung?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，往台中的火車在哪個月台？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: It leaves at ten thirty-five, and it is an express train.
sentences.zh: 十點三十五分發車，是一班快車。
sentences.note: express train 指停靠站較少的快車。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That train leaves from platform six.
sentences.zh: 那班車從第六月台發車。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Is platform six on this side?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: No. Take the escalator up and cross the bridge.
sentences.zh: 不是。請搭手扶梯上樓，再走過天橋。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: How long does it take to walk there?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: About five minutes, so you have plenty of time.
sentences.zh: 大約五分鐘，所以您的時間很充裕。
sentences.note: plenty of time 表示時間很充裕。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Great. Does the train stop at Hsinchu?
sentences.zh: 太好了。這班車有停新竹嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, it stops there before Taichung.
sentences.zh: 有，它會先停新竹，再到台中。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Do I need to show my ticket at the platform?
sentences.zh: 我需要在月台出示車票嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Keep it with you. The conductor may check it on the train.
sentences.zh: 請把票帶在身上。列車長可能會在車上驗票。
sentences.note: conductor 在此指列車長或驗票人員。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: You're welcome. Have a safe trip!

How does the traveler get to the platform?
